Definition: , or ῥαββουνί of Chaldee origin; corresponding to G4461:--Lord, Rabboni.
BiblicalUsage: When Jesus asked what he wanted, the blind man answered, Lord, that I might receive my sight, and the word behind Lord there is Rabboni. Mary turned at the empty tomb and cried, Rabboni, which is to say, Master. The Greek text behind the King James Version spells the word with a single vowel, while the text I have checked spells it ῥαββουνί, the same title in a fuller form.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Rabboni is the cry of a heart that has just been opened, whether the eyes or the tomb.
